Must Try in Phu Quoc
Sep 2026 • Friends
The Home Pizza Phu Quoc is an amazing restaurant where Italian cuisine perfectly captures the Vietnamese soul. Today, we tried the Durian Pizza—an explosive combination of the rich, sweet flavors of the tropical 'king of fruits' and cheese. Next up was a crispy pizza with sea urchin pate, brimming with local seafood flavors. Finally, we had the Crab Meat Cream Pasta, a famous Phu Quoc specialty. The atmosphere here is incredibly cozy, making it ideal for families, friends, or couples to share a meal and chat. A quick tip: you should definitely book a table in advance for dinner to secure the best seating.
